Subject:  Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”)- Schedule of Analyst/Investor 
Meeting 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with Para A (15)(a) of Part A of Schedule III 
thereto, this is to inform you that a conference call for analysts/institutional investors will be held on Tuesday, August 
04, 2026 at 09:00 a.m. (IST) in respect of the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company 
for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, as per the details attached herewith.  
 
We would like to further inform that the presentation to be made in the aforesaid conference call will be sent to stock 
exchanges and made available on the Company website on August 03, 2026, after the announcement of the results. 
 
The above disclosure is also being made available on the website of the Company at https://www.parkhospital.in/. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
For and on behalf of Park Medi World Limited
